sources.games: 308 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 47.7%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py gyrocopter.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Daedalus.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Gyrocopter players against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 33% of 21 games against them (6% otherwise), won 43% against 43%.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. High-rank Gyrocopter players against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 30% of 33 games against them (2% otherwise), won 90% against 35%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 82% (2), falcon_blade 84% (5), power_treads 94% (7), lesser_crit 90% (13), yasha 33% (15), dragon_lance 33% (17), manta 26% (17), ultimate_scepter 71% (18), black_king_bar 46% (24), greater_crit 67% (28), satanic 58% (31), butterfly 33% (32).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 80.0%+: 20:00 12500 (16 games, 81.2%), 30:00 20500 (47 games, 83.0%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold. No 85% line for this hero (two of the three minutes needed): the hero's own 80% line (scripts/hero_item_stats.py WIN_TARGETS). The 20:00 point rests on under 20 games, so it is left out (PLAN_POINT_GAMES).

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

suppress.illusions: Valve 7.41f Flak Cannon: for 12 s his attacks (4-7 of them) hit every enemy unit within 1250 of him, so a group of illusions takes each attack. High-rank Gyrocopters against illusion heroes: Maelstrom 11% of 18 games against them (3% otherwise), won 50% against 62% (a thin sample).

skills.basis: 308 games: maxed gyrocopter_flak_cannon > gyrocopter_rocket_barrage > gyrocopter_homing_missile 122 (win 48.4%), gyrocopter_rocket_barrage > gyrocopter_flak_cannon > gyrocopter_homing_missile 83 (win 51.8%), gyrocopter_flak_cannon > gyrocopter_homing_missile > gyrocopter_rocket_barrage 35 (win 34.3%); talents 10: +150 Health 288/307 (48.6%), Homing Missile Damage 19/307 (36.8%); 15: Flak Cannon Damage 277/287 (49.1%), Homing Missile Stun Duration 10/287 (80.0%); 20: Flak Cannon Attacks 199/205 (55.3%), Rocket Barrage Damage 6/205 (66.7%); 25: Flak Cannon Cooldown 45/46 (64.4%), Call Down Cooldown 1/46 (100.0%).
